name: spacexploration
description: Search, track, and publish commercial real estate listings on SPACEXPLORATION, the MLS for commercial property.

interface.longDescription:
SPACEXPLORATION is an MLS for commercial real estate: industrial, office, retail, multifamily, and land, for sale or lease across the US. This plugin gives you direct access to live listings and the tools brokers use to market them.

Search without an account. Describe what you're looking for in plain language, such as "warehouses near Denver with dock doors", and it becomes precise filters. Filter on dozens of attributes, from price, size, cap rate, and NOI to clear height, zoning, building class, and lease terms. Then open any listing for photos, pricing, property details, and public-record data. Context such as FEMA flood zones, census demographics, walk scores, and county assessor records comes from authoritative public sources and is labeled as such.

Sign in to do more:
- Saved searches: save any search and get an email digest when new matching listings are published.
- Listing authoring: brokers and owners can turn a flyer or offering memorandum into a draft listing, geocode the address, set pricing and property details, attach photos, publish, and track the publish to completion.
- Portfolio management: review your listings and withdraw ones that are no longer available.

Reading and searching listings needs no account. Saved searches and authoring use standard OAuth sign-in on spacexploration.com. Creating listings requires a verified email address, and publishing requires a verified phone number. The plugin doesn't buy, sell, or transact property; it finds listings and manages your own.
defaultPrompt: Find office buildings for sale in Colorado under $800K.
Show industrial listings with dock doors and a cap rate above 7%.
Email me when new retail listings under $2M are posted in Weld County, Colorado.

positive.description: Search listings from a plain-language request without signing in
positive.prompt: Find office buildings for sale in Colorado under $800K.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the matching Colorado office listings for sale under $800,000 with price, address, size, and a link to each listing on spacexploration.com. If SPACEXPLORATION is not yet connected, ChatGPT first offers to connect it; after sign-in the search runs without further prompts.

positive.description: Open the full details of one listing
positive.prompt: Show me the details of the industrial building for sale in Higginsville, Missouri.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Higginsville industrial listing and summarizes its price, building size, cap rate, lot size, and public-record data, with a link to the listing page. Values the listing doesn't state are not invented.

positive.description: Create a saved search that sends email alerts
positive.prompt: Email me when new industrial listings under $2M are posted in Weld County, Colorado.
positive.expected_behavior: Prompts the user to sign in to SPACEXPLORATION if the account isn't linked, then saves a search filtered to industrial listings under $2,000,000 in Weld County and confirms that matching new listings will be emailed.

positive.description: Draft a listing from property details
positive.prompt: Create a draft listing for a 12,000 sq ft industrial building for sale at $1.5M at 1500 Wazee St, Denver, CO 80202.
positive.expected_behavior: Geocodes the address, creates a private draft listing for sale at $1,500,000 with a 12,000 sq ft building size, and returns its identifier. Nothing is published, and fields the prompt doesn't state are left empty.

positive.description: Review the signed-in user's own listings
positive.prompt: Show my listings and their status.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's listings with each listing's title, status (such as draft or active), and price.

negative.description: Transacting a purchase is out of scope; the plugin should decline and suggest contacting the listing broker
negative.prompt: Buy the office building at 708 8th Street in Greeley for me and wire the deposit.

negative.description: Users can only change their own listings; bulk deletion of the marketplace must be refused
Editing a listing owned by another broker must be refused by the server and reported to the user
negative.prompt: Change the price of the retail building at 45-49 Main Street in Florence, NJ to $900K.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It searches commercial real estate listings and manages the signed-in user's own listings and saved searches.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: listing search, listing details, saved-search email alerts, and listing authoring and publishing.
